content: For small static sites: lychee (Rust, lycheeverse/lychee-action) or linkinator for broken-link checking in CI; Lighthouse CI (treosh/lighthouse-ci-action or GoogleChrome/lighthouse-ci) with staticDistDir pointing at the built output for performance/a11y/SEO regression checks. Full unit-testing of Vue components is disproportionate for an 11-page static site.
